## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4004. The notification-worker email jobs were failing with DNS errors because the SMTP_HOST configuration still referenced `smtp-relay` by short name, which only resolves within the same namespace. After the smtp-relay service was moved to the shared-infra namespace, these lookups started failing. The fix is to update the SMTP_HOST configuration to use the fully qualified domain name `smtp-relay.shared-infra.svc.cluster.local` to reach the service across namespaces.
